words.meaning: 受訓人員；實習培訓人員
words.note: 強調正在接受工作或專業培訓；不一定是學生，也不一定短期。

exercises.original: The company hired three interns for the summer.

falseSynonyms.zh: 員工不等於 intern employee 只表示受僱；intern 通常帶學習、訓練或短期職場經驗目的。
falseSynonyms.point: An intern may be paid, but not every employee is an intern.

falseSynonyms.zh: 學徒只對部分 intern 情況 apprenticeship 通常較長期、制度化、職業技能導向。
falseSynonyms.point: An apprentice electrician usually follows a structured trade-training route.

falseSynonyms.zh: 很接近但範圍更廣 trainee 可以是正式員工、畢業生培訓生或職業培訓者，不一定是 internship。
falseSynonyms.point: All interns may be trainees in a broad sense, but not all trainees are interns.

falseSynonyms.zh: 義工不等於實習生 volunteer 核心是自願服務；intern 核心是工作學習／培訓安排。
falseSynonyms.point: A volunteer helps an organisation; an intern usually follows a learning or placement programme.

falseSynonyms.zh: 助理不等於實習生 assistant 是職務／職級名稱，可是正式長期工作。
falseSynonyms.point: A research assistant may be a regular employee, while an intern is typically in training.

falseSynonyms.zh: 只對短期學生體驗 sense 它常比 intern 更短期、更觀察導向。
falseSynonyms.point: A two-day school work-experience visit is not the same as a three-month internship.

falseSynonyms.zh: 只對畢業生培訓計劃 通常是正式招募後的 structured programme，和學生 internship 不同。
falseSynonyms.point: A graduate trainee may already be a full employee.

falseSynonyms.zh: 試用期員工不是 intern probationer 是已受僱、處於試用期的人，核心是僱傭評估而非實習學習。
falseSynonyms.point: A probationer is being assessed in a job; an intern is usually there to gain experience.
